1. Case Update - Lead Assignment
 Triggered when a user selects a lead in the "Assign Lead" dropdown and clicks "Save".
 Updates the case record with the assigned lead’s details and sends a notification to inform them of their responsibility.
2. Task Update - Task Complete
 Triggered when a user changes the Task status to "Completed”
 Updates the task’s status, and if all tasks linked to a case are completed, it updates the case status accordingly.
3. Case Update - Send For Approval
 Triggered when a user clicks "Send for Approval" only if the case status is not "Approved."
 Sends the case update to a designated reviewer or approver, ensuring oversight and compliance.
4. Case Update - Request Follow-Up
 Triggered when a user clicks "Request Follow-Up" only if a lead is assigned.
 Generates a follow-up request to the assigned party and tracks pending responses, ensuring timely resolution.
5. Case Update - Resolution Submission
 Triggered when a user clicks "Submit Resolution" only if the case status is not already "Resolved".
 Stores the resolution details, updates the case status, and notifies stakeholders about the resolution.
6. Update to Urgent Past Due Date Cases
 Automatically triggered on a scheduled basis if there are overdue cases.
 Identifies cases that have exceeded their due dates and updates their priority status to "Urgent," ensuring overdue cases receive immediate attention.
